paragraphs: Rabbi Natan ben Avshalom, a Tanna of a baraita.

Mentioned in [Berakhot 22a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.22a.6), in a dispute involving Rabbi Yose, Rabbi Yonatan ben Yosef, Rabbi Natan ben Avshalom, Rabbi Yochanan the Sandal-maker, and Rabbi Yehudah.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman lists Natan ben Avshalom himself among the speakers. The linked passage gives his own view on studying Gemara.
[Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2734&lang=en) likewise lists each speaker, including Natan, in its summary of this passage.
